cover_letter.greeting: Dear CIBC Private Wealth Investment Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the 2027 Summer Intern, Investment Communication role in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. This internship stood out because it sits where investment insight meets the people who use it, turning the team's views into materials for clients and advisors.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked on budget allocation across marketing channels and prepared executive-level investment briefs that brought together financial analysis, sector trends and performance data for senior leadership. I also moved funding away from underperforming channels, which drove a 1.5x increase in performance metrics. At Lenovo I created data-driven pitch materials and AI powered dashboards that combined predictive metrics with financial projections.

That maps to drafting market commentaries, reports and presentations alongside the Investment, Performance, Marketing and Compliance teams. I've spent my career around both the numbers and how they get presented, and I write plainly. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the internship.
